It

to
pay

rent
or
interest
of

or even
$100,
per
acre on

one
or two

to
take the
same quality of land

ing

difficulty of

more
than
counterbalance
the
difference
in
the
rental

the
land.

We
use cold frames for preserving Cauliflower, Cab-
